comment: Single source of truth for limits shared by C# and GLSL. The build (build/Shaders.targets) generates MainframeEngine/Src/Rendering/Generated/ShaderLimits.g.cs and Content/Shaders/include/limits.glsl from this file; edit here, never there. One limit per line, keys in this order.

limits.summary: Directional lights in the lights UBO.
Point lights in the lights UBO.
Spot lights in the lights UBO.
Shadowed directional lights: the first casts cascades, the others get an atlas tile each.
Shadowed spot lights (atlas tiles): every spot light can cast (M4: the atlas cut the shadow samplers from 15 to 6).
Shadowed point lights (cube maps, six passes each).
Cascades of the primary directional light (layers of the cascade array).
Atlas tiles: secondary directional lights (MAX_SHADOW_DIR - 1) plus spot lights (MAX_SHADOW_SPOT).
